       3             Heroin addiction, as most of you know, is a

       4      problem in our -- is a growing problem in our

       5      communities.  It is making its way into our schools,

       6      tearing families apart, and destroying lives.

       7             What was once a hard, but relatively

       8      inaccessible drug, has now transitioned into a cheap

       9      and widely available drug that's made it

      10      exponentially more deadly.

      11             It is time to focus on more effective

      12      prevention and treatment programs in order to combat

      13      this epidemic, improve the lives of those affected.

      14      and take back our streets from the drug dealers.

      15             This is happening everywhere: upstate,

      16      downstate; rich, poor, middle-class; urban,

      17      suburban, rural.

      18             There's probably not a parent or a family

      25             "In New York State, one of the probation's

       1      most taunting constraints is a startling lack of

       2      resources.  National academic and policy experts on

       1      New York State where, over the last two decades, the
